### [Anthropic’s best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive](https://simonwillison.net/2026/Aug/23/anthropics-best-ai-model-struggles-to-attract-users-as-cheaper-t/)

**Simon Willison** · 2026-08-23

Anthropic's July 2026 annualized revenue reached $65bn, but enterprise spending data reveals high costs are hindering adoption of its flagship Fable 5 model relative to older variants like Opus 4.8.

- Anthropic reported $65bn in annualized revenue for July 2026, up from $47bn in May, with 6,000 enterprise customers spending at least $100,000 annually.
- OpenAI's annualized revenue rose 35% in the quarter to cross $40bn, driven by the July release of GPT 5.6.
- Ramp AI index billing data shows Opus 4.8 dominated Anthropic model spend in July at 28.0%, while Fable 5 captured only 8.0% due to cost constraints.
- Newer models Opus 5 (released July 24th) and Sonnet 5 accounted for 3.5% and 3.6% of spending, respectively.

**Why it matters:** Enterprise LLM spending is heavily cost-sensitive, driving higher utilization of previous-generation or cheaper models over newly released flagship offerings.
